POSTPONED PROCEEDINGS - At the conclusion of debate on H. Res. 1530, the Chair put the question on ordering the previous question and by voice vote, announced that the ayes had prevailed. Mr. McGovern demanded the yeas and nays and the Chair postponed further proceedings until a time to be announced.
DEBATE - The House proceeded with one hour of debate on H. Res. 1530.
Placed on the House Calendar, Calendar No. 90.

The resolution provides for consideration of H.R. 9576, H.R. 10326, H.J.Res. 210, and H.J.Res. 213 under a closed rule with one hour of debate and one motion to recommit on each measure. The resolution provides for a motion to concur in the Senate amendments to H.R. 5334.
The House Committee on Rules reported an original measure, H. Rept. 119-825, by Mrs. Fischbach.
